mapper.select: SELECT * FROM attendance_session WHERE course_id = #{courseId} ORDER BY start_time DESC

SELECT COUNT(1) AS totalSessions, COALESCE(SUM(session_stat.expectedCount), 0) AS expectedTotal, COALESCE(SUM(session_stat.actualCount), 0) AS actualTotal, COALESCE(SUM(session_stat.absentCount), 0) AS absentTotal, COALESCE(SUM(session_stat.lateCount), 0) AS lateTotal FROM ( SELECT a.session_id, IFNULL(a.total_student, COUNT(ar.record_id)) AS expectedCount, SUM(CASE WHEN ar.status IN (1, 2) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS actualCount, SUM(CASE WHEN ar.status = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS absentCount, SUM(CASE WHEN ar.status = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lateCount FROM attendance_session a INNER JOIN course c ON a.course_id = c.course_id LEFT JOIN attendance_record ar ON a.session_id = ar.session_id
GROUP BY a.session_id, a.total_student ) session_stat

SELECT a.session_id FROM attendance_session a INNER JOIN course c ON a.course_id = c.course_id
ORDER BY a.start_time DESC, a.session_id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO attendance_session (course_id, source_images, total_student, actual_student, start_time) VALUES (#{courseId}, #{sourceImages}, #{totalStudent}, #{actualStudent}, #{startTime})
